text: No, the tree cover on this property did not change in 2026. The evidence shows no detected tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger between 2021 and 2025, the latest year with valid observations. The data sources (Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020) confirm stable forest cover during this period, with no changes exceeding the minimum detectable threshold. However, smaller changes or those at the edges of the property may not be captured due to the 30-meter pixel resolution.
